relations: The hot contents of the stationary mug drive continuous steam emission from its rim.
The rising vapor churns turbulently, broadening, looping, and narrowing as it dissipates upward.
The stationary mug and background contrast with the dynamic, varying brightness of the ascending steam.
caption: The video captures a white mug with a black handle resting on a light wooden tabletop, backlit by a bright, blurred window against a soft-focus wall of orange-and-white tiles. A plume of white steam rises continuously from the rim, already in motion at the start and still rising at the end. The vapor churns in turbulent, shifting shapes rather than moving as a rigid body, broadening and billowing toward the upper right early in the clip. Midway, the swirling steam folds into a distinct loop that curls above the rim before loosening again. In the latter part, the plume narrows into a vertical, wispy column that leans slightly left. Throughout, the mug and its handle appear stationary, and the window and table edge stay in place, with no obvious camera movement. The steam's brightness and density vary as it climbs and dissipates, yet a steady emission from the rim is maintained.
